regression_scope.criteria: Original reference bytes, visibility, first-floor frame intervals, coordinates and spatial tolerances are immutable. No near miss is promoted and no visibility denominator is changed after predictions.
regression_scope.qualitative_protection: Preserve all five strict baseline successes and the independently source-reviewed ordinary12A borderline true object. Strict misses remain misses; wrong-object regressions must not hide behind miss-to-miss counts.

new_holdout_scope.release: No reference positions, frame intervals, per-video visibility conclusions or predictions are exposed to algorithm agents/root before a new code/configuration freeze and explicit root release.
new_holdout_scope.limits: Same-project, current-round heldouts only. Historical project-wide inventory/CV/AI exposure may exist. No globally unseen or independent-human-ground-truth claim.

stage_replay.real_frames_required: Verified original BGR analysis pixels, exact source SHA/frame count/shape/timestamps/preprocessing; immutable array hash and sequence digest.
stage_replay.detector_reuse: Only when detector code/configuration and preprocessing are identical to the source of reused observations. Changed detector paths need fresh measured candidates with separate input/model provenance.
stage_replay.calibration_reuse: Only unchanged calibration code/configuration; otherwise fresh calibration required.
stage_replay.default_scope: Tracking, event proposals, identity application and review selection on actual cached pixels; no fresh detector/native-contact/evidence passes. Compare with the same-stage baseline; do not call this a full fresh pipeline accuracy measurement.
stage_replay.final_scope: Final accepted code must revalidate all changed stages. Eight new heldouts and original A1/B1 controls require fresh complete execution after freeze.

pair_consistency.allowed_cues: Raw-source audio synchronization or independently recognizable non-landing actions; calibration must be declared before scoring and must not use frozen landing labels/predictions to choose the alignment.
pair_consistency.unverified_pair_behavior: Keep views independent; do not assume equal source start times, frame indices or a shared landing event.
pair_consistency.spatial_consistency: No cross-view pixel-distance comparison without independently verified common court/world calibration.
